tasks.short: Understand the manual and the drawing for this job.

steps.what: Read the drawing card before this job.
Understand operating manuals, blueprints, and technical drawings on this equipment.
outputs: what the drawing requires on this equipment

tasks.design: A yard colleague writes a drawing card before the job. The card holds the equipment name, the manual title, and the plate number. The mobile equipment mechanic reads the card, then still reads and understands the operating manual, the blueprint, and the technical drawing on the equipment. If the card has no row, the mechanic reads the paper manual list inside the same step.
tasks.previous_blocker: The preferred drawing sat in a folder the mechanic opened at the start of the job.
tasks.enabler_now: A paper drawing card with the equipment name, the manual title, and the plate number is enough to start. No system is required.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding the drawing on the equipment still takes the time.
tasks.human_edge: Only the mechanic can judge what the drawing requires on this equipment.
tasks.altitude: A card shortens finding the drawing. The mechanic still understands it on the equipment.

evidence.claim: A paper card with the equipment name, the manual title, and the plate number shortens the search when the row is there. The mechanic still reads and understands the drawing. Model knowledge.
